policy: Recommendation 5 enforced cap on T01 self-verification generation. The T01 graph-mutation negative family is held at the variants already built with correct, self-policed rejection. Generating further graph-semantic variants is refused by the construction tooling unless root sets the explicit override, because each remaining variant is a multi-day per-family oracle-injection reconstruction (proven hands-on by driving F13-01 twelve layers to the oracle) and re-attests a checker whose soundness for these families is already covered by the built set and the frozen design.
capped_family: T01 graph-mutation negatives (DESIGN-v1 family_cases, 64-variant planned population)

override.how: set environment variable T01_CAMPAIGN_OVERRIDE=root-approved to permit generation beyond the cap
override.who: root only; this is a deliberate multi-day compute-and-authoring campaign, not a default
override.note: The override exists so the cap is a held limit with a documented release, not a silent refusal.
